sourceFitAssessment.learnerTask: Separate prodrug activation, DNA/RNA metabolite effects and host clearance
sourceFitAssessment.gap: No branched visual distinguishes drug activation from DPD breakdown
sourceFitAssessment.accuracyGuardrails: Normal and tumor cells activate; DPYD not tumor sensitivity; no dose/testing directive derived from image
sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: The three panels distinguish compressed capecitabine activation, FdUMP-related DNA precursor limitation and FUTP RNA incorporation in normal AND tumor cells, then separate host DPD breakdown. The neighboring text identifies thymidylate synthase and correctly separates DPYD encoding of DPD from tumor sensitivity. The label supports both metabolites and the separate 5-FU catabolic pathway; tumor-to-adjacent-tissue ratios in that label do not establish exclusive tumor activation. The inherited FDA testing statement matches the currently retrieved safety update and is not a testing/dose instruction derived from this image. CREATE-X is confined to its postoperative HER2-negative residual-invasive-disease setting, without modern regimen-combination inference.
